Senses.PreferredTarget: on the lump of red flesh
AlternateTargets: on this mass of bare flesh
Senses.Explanation: Literally, "on" or "upon" (上) the "lump of red flesh" (赤肉團): "on the lump of red flesh," attested 316 times in 144 allowlisted texts. Its most frequent named deployment quotes Linji: "on the lump of red flesh there is a true person of no rank, constantly going in and out through the face-gate of each of you; those who have not verified this, look, look" (赤肉團上有一無位真人，常在汝諸人面門出入，未證據者看看). The phrase also heads Nanyuan Huiyong's recorded saying, "on the lump of red flesh, a wall stands a thousand fathoms" (赤肉團上，壁立千仞), followed by a monk repeating the sentence and overturning the Chan seat. Later records quote both formulations, combine the phrase with the "true person of no rank" (無位真人), and use it as the location of other stated predicates. The broader form "lump of red flesh" (赤肉團) occurs 441 times, while "beside the lump of red flesh" (赤肉團邊) occurs 36 times. No exact occurrence using "inside" in place of "on" was found. The entry preserves the literal bodily wording and the two principal recorded sayings without replacing them with an imported abstraction.
Senses.Note: The Linji and Nanyuan sayings are distinct public-record lines and are not cross-attributed. Linji's line is transmitted in his own collected record and many lamp and commentarial witnesses. Nanyuan's line generates a separate exchange: the monk asks whether it is the master's saying, overturns the Chan seat after confirmation, is rebuked, deliberates, and is driven out. The phrase itself receives no separate one-line lexical definition in the searched formula set.

Occurrences.Kwic: 上堂云赤肉團上有一無位真人
Occurrences.AttributionNote: In Linji Yixuan's own collected record: "he addressed the assembly, saying: on the lump of red flesh there is a true person of no rank."

Occurrences.Kwic: 示眾云：赤肉團上有一無位真人，常在汝諸人面門出入，未證據者看看。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Linji's section of the Linked Lamps preserves the fuller statement: "on the lump of red flesh there is a true person of no rank, constantly going in and out through the face-gate of each of you; those who have not verified this, look, look."

Occurrences.Kwic: 上堂云赤肉團上壁立千仞有僧問赤肉團上壁立千仞豈不是和尚語
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Old Recorded Sayings of Venerable Masters (古尊宿語錄), in Muzhou Daoming's section, not a Nanyuan Huiyong record. Muzhou Daoming first delivers the hall statement containing 赤肉團上; an unnamed monk immediately repeats it in his question.

Occurrences.Kwic: 南院顒禪師。上堂：赤肉團上，壁立千仞。僧問：赤肉團上，壁立千仞，豈不是和尚道？
Occurrences.AttributionNote: 列祖提綱錄: complete-case exact-turn review identifies Nanyuan Huiyong as the actor for this occurrence.

Occurrences.Kwic: 與赤肉團上無位真人現前清淨大眾。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: In Dahui Zonggao's summer-retreat address: "together with the present assembly and the true person of no rank on the lump of red flesh."
